explanation: The value depends mostly on the trial step: it is always near the top at D2 (10, sometimes 9), high at D1 (about 9, or 10 after a run of rewarded trials, 8 after a no-reward trial), and near the bottom at GO (about 1, rising to 2-3 after a no-reward trial and dropping to 0 late in the episode). Late in the episode (trial 85 and later), and above all while choosing a2, D1 falls to about 4-7 (lower after no reward) and D2 slips to 9.
